# PhysicalReservoirs

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
Reservoir computing systems implemented in physical dynamical substrates whose high-dimensional transient responses perform computation. They bridge iNEST in-network neuromorphic hardware with reservoir-based temporal processing for topology-centric computation.
